pairs.a: Neighbors gathered outside the town hall, where the council planned to abolish the local tax.
pairs.b: Neighbors gathered outside the town hall, where the council planned to establish the local tax.

pairs.a: Late on a cold December evening, the village committee announced plans to abolish its annual festival.
pairs.b: Late on a cold December evening, the village committee announced plans to establish its annual festival.

pairs.a: Thunder rolled over the valley as the mayor's office debated whether to abolish the ferry service.

pairs.b: A handwritten poster beside the counter promised the society would soon establish the regional chapter.
